task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Lisa, the IT manager at Kauri Foods, asking for access. You need the Contributor role on the Kauri Foods production subscription to deploy the new monitoring. You'd like it by Wednesday, and it can be removed after the project.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 IT 经理 Lisa 写一封邮件（60–100 词），申请权限。你需要 Kauri Foods 生产订阅的 Contributor 角色来部署新的监控。希望周三前开通，项目结束后可以收回。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Could you please give me the Contributor role on the Kauri Foods production subscription?
I need it to deploy the new monitoring we agreed on last week. I'm planning to start on Wednesday, so it would be great to have access by then.
I'm happy for the access to be removed once the project finishes at the end of January, or to have it time-limited if that's easier for you.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Paul, the IT manager at Harbour Council, asking for information. For the cloud assessment, you need a list of all their applications with the business owner for each one. You need it by 4 December. A rough list is fine.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 IT 经理 Paul 写一封邮件（70–110 词），索要信息。为了做云评估，你需要他们所有应用的清单，以及每个应用的业务负责人。你需要在 12 月 4 日前拿到。粗略的清单就可以。
example:
Hi Paul,
For the cloud assessment, could you send me a list of all your applications, with the business owner for each one?
We'll use it to work out which apps can move first and who we need to talk to about each one. A rough list in Excel is completely fine. It doesn't need to be perfect, and we can fill the gaps together.
If possible, could you send it by 4 December? That keeps the assessment on track for Christmas.
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: it doesn't need to be perfect
we can fill in the gaps later

task: Write a polite follow-up email (60–90 words) to Mark at Kauri Foods. You sent him the statement of work for the payroll upgrade on 10 November for signature, and he hasn't replied. You'd like it signed by 27 November so the team can start on 7 December.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Mark 写一封礼貌的跟进邮件（60–90 词）。你 11 月 10 日把薪资系统升级的工作说明书（SOW）发给他签字，他还没回复。你希望 11 月 27 日前签好，这样团队可以 12 月 7 日开工。
example:
Hi Mark,
Just following up on the statement of work for the payroll upgrade, which I sent on 10 November.
If you're able to sign it by 27 November, our team can start on 7 December as planned. If you have any questions or want to change anything, I'm happy to jump on a call.
I've attached it again here to save you looking for it.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write a second, firmer follow-up email (70–110 words) to Paul at Harbour Council. You asked for the firewall details two weeks ago and followed up last week, with no reply. Without them, the build can't start, and the start date of 30 November will move. Stay polite.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写第二封、语气更坚定的跟进邮件（70–110 词）。你两周前就要了防火墙信息，上周也跟进过，一直没回复。没有这些信息搭建就无法开始，11 月 30 日的开工日期也会推迟。保持礼貌。
example:
Hi Paul,
I'm following up again on the firewall details I asked for on 6 November.
Without them, we can't start the build, and the start date of 30 November will have to move. Each week of delay also pushes back the go-live.
I know you're busy, so if it's easier, could you point me to someone in your network team who can help? A 15-minute call with them would be enough.
Could you let me know by Wednesday either way?
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: is there anyone else I could ask

task: Write an email (90–130 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods pushing back on scope creep. You're migrating their email to Exchange Online. She has asked you to also move their SharePoint sites as part of the same project. That isn't in the statement of work. Offer a change request with a quote.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封邮件（90–130 词），对范围蔓延提出异议。你们在把他们的邮件迁到 Exchange Online。她要求在同一个项目里顺便把 SharePoint 站点也迁了。这不在工作说明书里。提出走变更申请并附报价。
example:
Hi Lisa,
Thanks for asking about the SharePoint sites. It makes sense to move them, but it isn't part of the current project.
Our statement of work covers the email migration to Exchange Online only. Moving SharePoint is a separate piece of work, with its own planning, testing and user training, and it would take about three weeks.
If we add it without a change, the email migration would be delayed, and I don't want that to happen.
What I suggest: I'll send you a change request with a quote and timeline by Friday. Then you can decide whether to add it now or do it as a follow-on project in the new year.
Does that work for you?
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: not in the statement of work

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to Paul at Harbour Council, saying no politely. He has asked if your team can work this Saturday at no charge to make up for the firewall delay. The delay was on the council's side. Say no, and offer two alternatives.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一封邮件（80–120 词），礼貌地拒绝。他问你的团队能不能这周六免费加班，弥补防火墙造成的延误。延误是市政厅那边造成的。拒绝他，并提供两个替代方案。
example:
Hi Paul,
Thanks for asking. Unfortunately we can't do Saturday work at no charge, as the firewall delay was outside our control.
I do want to help get the project back on track, though, so here are two options:
- We work this Saturday at our standard weekend rate. I can send you a quote today.
- We add a second engineer next week at normal rates, which would recover most of the lost time without any weekend work.
I think the second option is better value. Let me know which you'd prefer, and I'll set it up.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.zh: 按我们周末的标准费率

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to Mark at Kauri Foods proposing an alternative. He wants the payroll go-live on 23 December. You suggest 12 January instead, because many of their staff and your support team will be on holiday over Christmas.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Mark 写一封邮件（80–120 词），提出替代方案。他希望薪资系统 12 月 23 日上线。你建议改到 1 月 12 日，因为圣诞期间他们很多员工和你们的支持团队都在放假。
example:
Hi Mark,
I'd like to suggest moving the payroll go-live from 23 December to 12 January.
The main reason is support. Over Christmas, many of your payroll staff and most of our support team will be on holiday. If something goes wrong in the first pay run, it would be hard to get the right people together quickly.
Going live on 12 January means everyone is back, and we'd have a full team on hand for the first two weeks. The first pay run in the new system would be on 20 January.
Happy to talk it through if you'd prefer to keep the December date.
Kind regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Janet at Coastal Dental confirming what you agreed on the phone today. 1) The server move happens on Saturday 12 December from 6pm. 2) The clinics will be closed, so no staff will be affected. 3) Janet will be on call in case you need her.
zh: 给 Coastal Dental 的 Janet 写一封邮件（70–110 词），确认你们今天电话里商定的内容。1）服务器迁移在 12 月 12 日（周六）晚上 6 点开始。2）诊所届时关门，不会影响员工。3）Janet 会随时待命，以防你们需要她。
example:
Hi Janet,
Thanks for the call today. Just to confirm what we agreed:
1. The server move will happen on Saturday 12 December, starting at 6pm.
2. The clinics will be closed then, so no staff will be affected.
3. You'll be on call that evening in case we need you. I'll only call if something needs a decision.
I'll send a reminder on Thursday and an update when the move is finished. If any of this doesn't match your notes, please let me know.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: on call in case we need you

task: Write an email (70–110 words) introducing yourself to Helen, the new CIO at Harbour Council. You're taking over from Tom as the lead consultant on their Azure migration from next Monday. Tom is moving to another project but will stay in touch. Suggest a 30-minute meeting.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 新上任的首席信息官 Helen 写一封自我介绍的邮件（70–110 词）。从下周一起，你接替 Tom 成为他们 Azure 迁移项目的首席顾问。Tom 要去做另一个项目，但会保持联系。建议约一个 30 分钟的会议。
example:
Hi Helen,
My name is {name}, and I'm a {role} at {company}. From next Monday, I'll be taking over from Tom as the lead consultant on your Azure migration.
Tom is moving to another project, but he'll stay in touch over the next few weeks to make sure nothing is lost in the handover.
I'd love to meet you and hear what matters most to you for the project. Would you have 30 minutes next week? I'm happy to come to your office or meet on Teams.
Looking forward to working with you.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: I look forward to working with you

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Paul at Harbour Council requesting a meeting. You'd like 45 minutes next week to review the disaster recovery design before it's finalised. His network engineer should also come. Suggest two times.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一封邮件（60–100 词），请求开会。你希望下周用 45 分钟，在灾备设计定稿前一起评审。他的网络工程师也应该参加。建议两个时间。
example:
Hi Paul,
Could we meet for 45 minutes next week to review the disaster recovery design before we finalise it?
It would be great if your network engineer could join too, as some of the decisions affect your on-prem network.
Would either of these work?
- Tuesday 24 November, 10am
- Thursday 26 November, 2pm
I'll send the draft design two days before, so there's time to read it.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to your manager Grace asking for training budget. You'd like to do a 3-day AZ-700 networking course in February. It costs $1,200. Explain how it helps your current work.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一封邮件（60–100 词），申请培训预算。你想在二月参加一个为期 3 天的 AZ-700 网络课程，费用 1,200 元。说明它对你目前的工作有什么帮助。
example:
Hi Grace,
I'd like to ask for $1,200 from the training budget for a 3-day AZ-700 networking course in February.
Most of my current work, especially Harbour Council and Coastal Dental, involves Azure networking, and it's the area where I rely on Raj the most. The course would help me design and troubleshoot networks on my own and get the AZ-700 certification.
I'll plan the dates around the Harbour Council cutover. Let me know what you think.
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: fill a gap in my skills

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Ben in your company's networking team asking for help. You've set up ExpressRoute for Harbour Council and want an expert to review the routing before it goes live on 3 December. It should take about an hour.
zh: 给公司网络团队的 Ben 写一封邮件（70–110 词），请求帮助。你给 Harbour Council 配置了 ExpressRoute，想在 12 月 3 日上线前请专家检查一下路由。大概需要一个小时。
example:
Hi Ben,
Could you help me with a review? I've set up ExpressRoute for Harbour Council, and I'd like an expert to check the routing before it goes live on 3 December.
It's my first ExpressRoute build, so I want to make sure I haven't missed anything, especially the route filters and failover to the VPN.
It should take about an hour. Would sometime early next week work for you? I'll send the design and the current config beforehand.
Thanks heaps,
{name}

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Rachel in your company's sales team. She wants you to join a presales meeting with a new client next Tuesday. You're fully booked on the Kauri Foods go-live that day. Say no, and suggest Raj, who has done similar work.
zh: 给公司销售团队的 Rachel 写一封邮件（60–100 词）。她想让你下周二参加一个新客户的售前会议。那天你全天都在忙 Kauri Foods 的上线。拒绝她，并推荐做过类似工作的 Raj。
example:
Hi Rachel,
Thanks for thinking of me. Unfortunately I can't make next Tuesday, as I'm on the Kauri Foods go-live all day.
Raj would be a great fit, though. He led a very similar AVD project for a retail client earlier this year and knows the costs well. I've copied him in here.
If it would help, I'm happy to spend 20 minutes with you both on Monday to go through the client's background.
Cheers,
{name}

words.zh: 乐意给 Raj 介绍情况

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to the account manager at your Microsoft licence distributor asking for a price. You need pricing for 50 Microsoft 365 Business Premium licences on a 12-month term for a client. You need the quote by Friday.
zh: 给你们的微软许可证分销商的客户经理写一封邮件（60–100 词），询价。你需要为一个客户报价 50 个 Microsoft 365 Business Premium 许可证，12 个月期限。你需要在周五前拿到报价。
example:
Hi Sam,
Could you please send me a quote for 50 Microsoft 365 Business Premium licences on a 12-month term?
They're for a client in the healthcare sector who is moving from on-prem Exchange. If there's any promotion or discount for new customers at the moment, please include that too.
I'd need the quote by Friday, as we're presenting to the client next Monday.
Thanks,
{name}

words.en: could you send me a quote

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to your manager Grace pushing back on a deadline. She wants the full Coastal Dental design document in 2 days. You think it needs 4 days to do properly. Propose sending the network and security sections in 2 days and the rest 2 days later.
zh: 给经理 Grace 写一封邮件（80–120 词），对截止日期提出异议。她希望 2 天内拿到完整的 Coastal Dental 设计文档。你认为要做好需要 4 天。建议 2 天内先交网络和安全部分，其余部分再过 2 天交。
example:
Hi Grace,
I've looked at the Coastal Dental design document, and I don't think I can do the full thing well in 2 days. It needs about 4.
The backup and DR sections depend on answers from Janet that we only got yesterday, and I'd rather not guess.
Here's what I suggest:
- Thursday: network and security sections, which are the ones the client is most keen to see.
- Monday: the rest of the document.
That way the client gets something useful this week, and the full document is solid. Would that work?
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods asking her to confirm a requirement in writing. In yesterday's meeting she asked for backups to be kept for 30 days instead of 14. This will add about $120 a month. Ask her to reply to confirm before you change it.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封邮件（70–110 词），请她书面确认一个需求。在昨天的会上，她要求备份保留 30 天而不是 14 天。这会每月增加大约 120 元。请她在你修改之前回复确认。
example:
Hi Lisa,
In yesterday's meeting, you asked us to keep backups for 30 days instead of 14. Before we make the change, could you please confirm it by replying to this email?
Just so you know, keeping backups for longer will add about $120 a month to your Azure bill.
Once you confirm, we'll update the backup policy the same day, and the change will apply to all production servers.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write a follow-up email (60–100 words) to Janet at Coastal Dental. You sent her a proposal for the Windows Server upgrade last Tuesday. Check whether she has any questions and offer a short call to go through it.
zh: 给 Coastal Dental 的 Janet 写一封跟进邮件（60–100 词）。你上周二把 Windows Server 升级的方案发给了她。问问她有没有问题，并提出可以简短通个电话一起过一遍。
example:
Hi Janet,
I hope your week's going well. I wanted to check in on the Windows Server upgrade proposal I sent last Tuesday.
Do you have any questions about it? I know there's quite a lot of detail in there, so I'm happy to go through it on a quick 20-minute call if that's easier. I'm free most of Thursday and Friday.
No rush, but it would be good to plan the work before the Christmas break.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: at a time that suits you

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Paul at Harbour Council asking for an extension. You promised the assessment report by this Friday. You need until next Tuesday because two application owners only replied yesterday. Say what he'll get on Friday.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一封邮件（60–100 词），请求延期。你答应这周五交评估报告。你需要延到下周二，因为有两个应用负责人昨天才回复。说明周五他能先拿到什么。
example:
Hi Paul,
Could I have until next Tuesday to send the assessment report, instead of this Friday?
Two of the application owners only replied yesterday, and I want to include their information properly rather than rush it.
On Friday, I'll send you the summary and the recommendations so you can start reading. The full report, with the details for every application, will follow on Tuesday.
Sorry for the change, and thanks for understanding.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (100–140 words) to Mark at Kauri Foods pushing back on a request to skip user acceptance testing (UAT) to save a week. Explain the risk simply: staff could be paid wrongly. Propose a shorter 2-day UAT that focuses on pay runs and leave.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Mark 写一封邮件（100–140 词），对他“跳过用户验收测试（UAT）以节省一周”的要求提出异议。简单解释风险：员工可能被发错工资。建议做一个缩短为 2 天、专注于发薪和休假的 UAT。
example:
Hi Mark,
I understand the pressure to save time, but I'd strongly recommend we don't skip user acceptance testing.
UAT is the only point where your payroll team checks the new system with real data. If we skip it, the first time anyone sees a real pay run would be on payday. If something is wrong, staff could be paid the wrong amount, and fixing that afterwards takes much longer than a week.
Here's an alternative: a shorter, 2-day UAT that focuses only on what matters most:
- Running a full pay run and comparing it with last month's.
- Checking leave balances for a sample of staff.
That saves three days and still covers the biggest risks.
Can we agree on this approach at Thursday's meeting?
Kind regards,
{name}

words.zh: 缩短为两天的验收测试

task: Write an email (60–100 words) introducing Paul, the IT manager at Harbour Council, to your colleague Sarah, a security specialist. Paul wants advice on getting ready for a security audit next year. Suggest they set up a call.
zh: 写一封邮件（60–100 词），把 Harbour Council 的 IT 经理 Paul 介绍给你的同事、安全专家 Sarah。Paul 想咨询如何为明年的安全审计做准备。建议他们约个电话。
example:
Hi Paul and Sarah,
I'd like to introduce you both.
Paul, Sarah is our security lead. She's helped several councils get ready for security audits, so she's the best person to talk to about next year's audit.
Sarah, Paul is the IT manager at Harbour Council. We've been working together on their Azure migration, and he'd like some advice on where to start with audit preparation.
Could you two set up a call when it suits? I'll leave it with you.
Cheers,
{name}

words.en: the right person to talk to

task: Write an email (60–100 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods asking for feedback on a deliverable. You've sent the draft AVD design. Ask her to review sections 3 (user profiles) and 5 (costs) in particular, and send comments by 4 December.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封邮件（60–100 词），请她对交付物提意见。你已经发出了 AVD 设计草稿。请她特别看一下第 3 部分（用户配置文件）和第 5 部分（成本），并在 12 月 4 日前反馈意见。
example:
Hi Lisa,
I've attached the draft AVD design for your review.
You don't need to read every page. The parts where I most need your input are:
- Section 3, user profiles: it explains how staff settings will move to the new desktops.
- Section 5, costs: it shows the monthly cost for 150 users.
Could you send me your comments by 4 December? Comments in the document are fine.
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write an email (80–120 words) to Janet at Coastal Dental to correct a misunderstanding. She thinks the $2,800 monthly price in your proposal includes Microsoft licences. It doesn't: licences are extra, about $650 a month. Be clear and apologise if the proposal wasn't clear.
zh: 给 Coastal Dental 的 Janet 写一封邮件（80–120 词），纠正一个误会。她以为你方案里每月 2,800 元的价格包含了微软许可证。其实不包含：许可证另算，每月大约 650 元。说清楚，并为方案写得不够清楚而道歉。
example:
Hi Janet,
I want to clear up one point about the proposal, as I think we've had a misunderstanding.
The $2,800 a month covers Azure hosting and our managed service, but it doesn't include Microsoft licences. Those are extra, at about $650 a month, so the total would be around $3,450.
I'm sorry the proposal didn't make that clear. It should have been on the summary page, not just in the detailed table. I've attached an updated version with the full monthly total.
Happy to talk it through if you have any questions.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: I apologise if it wasn't clear
words.zh: 如果没写清楚我很抱歉

task: Write a short email (60–90 words) to Paul at Harbour Council to reschedule tomorrow's 10am design meeting. You're sick and won't be in tomorrow. Suggest Thursday at the same time, or offer that Raj can run it instead.
zh: 给 Harbour Council 的 Paul 写一封简短的邮件（60–90 词），把明天上午 10 点的设计会议改期。你病了，明天不能来上班。建议改到周四同一时间，或者由 Raj 代你主持。
example:
Hi Paul,
I'm afraid I'm unwell and won't be working tomorrow, so I need to reschedule our 10am design meeting. Sorry for the late notice.
Two options:
- Move it to Thursday at 10am.
- Keep tomorrow's time, and Raj will run it. He knows the design well and can answer most questions.
Let me know which you'd prefer, and I'll update the invite.
Regards,
{name}

task: Write an email (70–110 words) to Lisa at Kauri Foods asking her to name a contact for the cutover. The payroll cutover runs from Saturday 8am to Sunday 6pm. You need someone from her team who can make decisions and test the system during that time. Ask for a name and mobile number by Wednesday.
zh: 给 Kauri Foods 的 Lisa 写一封邮件（70–110 词），请她指定一名割接联系人。薪资系统割接从周六早上 8 点持续到周日下午 6 点。你需要她团队里有一个人在这期间能做决定并测试系统。请她周三前提供姓名和手机号。
example:
Hi Lisa,
For the payroll cutover this weekend, could you nominate someone from your team as our contact?
The cutover runs from Saturday 8am to Sunday 6pm. We need someone who can:
- make decisions if something unexpected comes up, and
- test the system on Sunday afternoon, before we hand it over.
They won't need to be online the whole time. We'll call them when we need them.
Could you send me their name and mobile number by Wednesday?
Thanks,
{name}

task: Write a thank-you email (90–130 words) to Janet and Dr Patel at Coastal Dental at the end of the project. All 6 servers are now in Azure, and the project finished on time and on budget. Thank them, name one thing their team did well, and explain what happens next with support.
zh: 项目结束时，给 Coastal Dental 的 Janet 和 Patel 医生写一封感谢邮件（90–130 词）。6 台服务器都已迁到 Azure，项目按时、按预算完成。感谢他们，指出他们团队做得好的一件事，并说明接下来的支持安排。
example:
Hi Janet and Dr Patel,
Now that all 6 servers are running in Azure, I wanted to say a big thank you. We finished on time and on budget, and that's a credit to your team as much as ours.
In particular, Janet's weekly check-ins made a real difference. Whenever we had a question, we got an answer within a day, which kept the project moving.
What happens next: from 1 December, our managed services team will look after your environment. You can reach them through the service desk email or phone number in the handover pack. I'll also check in with you in January to see how everything's going.
It's been a pleasure working with you.
Kind regards,
{name}

words.en: your team did a great job
